The '''PLX-2M portable missile launcher''', sometimes referred to as the '''Plex-Twoem''', or '''Plex''', was a shoulder-mounted [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] and based on their earlier [[PLX-1/Legends|PLX-1]] model. The sheer explosive power of the PLX-2M made it dangerous to fire blindly in close quarters, but was extremely effective when used as a 'smart' tracking weapon. Once locked on to a target, the PLX-2M's missiles had a range of 50 kilometers.<ref name="Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==Description==
[[File:PLX-2M_egwt.png|thumb|left|180px|PLX-2M [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]].]]

The PLX-2M had a magazine of six [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[3t3 missile]]s, and included a miniature [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] generator to aid in carrying the heavy weapon. Other missiles were sometimes used, including armor piercing anti-vehicle shells, explosive "bunker busters", gas delivery systems, and [[Gravity-Activated Mode guided missile|GAM guided missiles]].<ref name="Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

This weapon also included a holographic [[Heads-up display/Legends|heads-up display]] that gave the user information about his or her target, including its speed, range, and what defensive shields it had. This weapon had two "smart" missile firing modes. In one mode, the missile acted as a heat-seeker. In the other mode, the missiles homed in on the gravity distortion fields created by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines. The PLX-2M could also be dumbfired to avoid hitting friendly vehicles. Despite its complexity, the PLX-2M could be assembled and ready for battle in less than a minute, and, because of the microrepulsorlifts, could be carried over almost any terrain and could be easily mounted and fired from the shoulder. It was popular with infantry attacks against tanks and small fighters.<ref name="Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

==History==
Originally designed for the Empire at the start of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the PLX-2M was a durable weapon that could be easily transported by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] or other soldiers.<ref name="Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology" />

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn's]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] was damaged by a hit from a shoulder-fired missile, "''probably plex-twoems''", during the [[Battle of Liinade III]]. He was able to land safely.<ref name="Xw:IR" />
